name: Editorial Serif
tagline: Warm off-white page, huge Instrument Serif headlines, a single vermilion accent, mono labels and hairline-ruled KPI strips; follows dark mode.

palette.description: Paper white with ink text and one vermilion accent; a dark palette switches in with system dark mode.

typography.style: Large display serif for headlines, neutral sans for reading text, JetBrains Mono for labels and numbers.

best_for: Evidence-led talks where a few strong headlines, KPI numbers and before and after contrasts carry the story. Gives engineering and strategy content an editorial calm.
navigation: inline keyboard handler (ArrowRight/Down/Space, scroll-snap, outline with O)
